Tenant 73 now produces the same 14,802 aggregates with 37 queries instead of 2,417, runtime dropping from 38.6s to 4.27s, and `build_summary` profiling from 39.1s to 4.46s. Added a 37-query regression assertion; invoice report tests pass (18/18), broader reports pass (63 passed, 2 PostgreSQL skips), and Ruff is clean.

A covering index on invoices was rejected due to ingest latency. Any future changes to `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` require fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output in its `EXAMPLES.md`.

Payroll CLI steps and the SQLAlchemy 1.4-to-2.0 model upgrade remain outstanding. PDF renderer work has only begun: baseline invoice PDF tests pass (12 passed, 1 skipped), and `render_invoice()` currently uses `_format_lines()` on a two-page canvas.
